name: Yusa Rinko
source:
School: 1st year Moriyoh Gakuen
Description: girl with many secrets
Profile: She's the school idol, probably because of her looks, and good 
upbringing.  She's usually busy and somewhat spoiled.  She doesn't have many 
friends as her social life is restricted, she also seems like she has secrets 
that she doesn't want to share with people.  She wants to become independent 
like her mother. Her hobby is collecting tropical fishes, and she loves her 
Puru Puru.
